FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Good evening, Madam!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Bonsoir, Madame !
   B. Salut, Kamau !
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Enchanté !

2. How do you say 'Yes, I am fine.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Bonsoir, Madame !
   B. Oui, ça va.
   C. Ça va bien, merci.
   D. Salut, Kamau !

3. How do you say 'Here is my house.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est le chat ?
   B. Voici ma maison.
   C. C'est un lit.
   D. C'est une table.

4. What does 'je me repose' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. I rest
   C. I sing
   D. today

5. What does 'le jour' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the day
   B. the church
   C. the school
   D. the week

6. What number is 'trois' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 25
   C. 4
   D. 9

7. What number is 'vingt et un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 19
   D. 25

8. What number is 'quatre' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 31
   D. 14

9. What does 'la mangue' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the tomato
   B. the orange
   C. fish
   D. the mango

10. How do you say 'She is short.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un nez.
   B. Elle est petite.
   C. Il est grand.
   D. Il a les cheveux courts.

11. How do you say 'She has black hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai une bouche.
   B. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   C. Il est grand.
   D. J'ai deux pieds.

12. How do you say 'I have two eyes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. J'ai deux pieds.
   C. J'ai une bouche.
   D. J'ai deux yeux.

13. What does 'la pluie' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the weather
   B. the cloud
   C. the rain
   D. the snow

14. What does 'agréable' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the rain
   B. pleasant
   C. the cloud
   D. strong

15. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is hot.
   B. It is freezing.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is raining.

16. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: What is the brother called? (1 mark)
   A. Njeri
   B. Kamau
   C. Grace
   D. Amina

17. What does 'Mon père s'appelle David.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is it?
   B. My mother is called Grace.
   C. My father is called David.
   D. This is my sister.

18. Which little word goes with 'table' (the table)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

19. Read: Voici ma maison. Dans la cuisine, il y a une table et deux chaises. Le frigo est près de la porte. Mon lit est sous la fenêtre. Question: What is near the door? (1 mark)
   A. the bed
   B. the sofa
   C. the cat
   D. the fridge

20. What does 'Voici ma maison.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. Here is my house.
   D. The ball is behind the door.

21. What does 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. On Monday, I go to school.
   C. On Sunday, I go to church.
   D. Tomorrow it is Thursday.

22. What does 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest.
   B. What day is it today?
   C. Today it is Monday.
   D. On Thursday, I sing.

23. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 mai.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My birthday is on 12 May.
   B. Happy birthday!
   C. Here is a present for you.
   D. I am nine years old.

24. What does 'Tu as quel âge ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. How old are you?
   B. Thank you very much!
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. My birthday is on 12 May.

25. Fill in: Mon anniversaire, c'est le 12 ______. (1 mark)
   A. jour
   B. dix
   C. lundi
   D. mai

26. What does 'Je mange une mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. It is a cake.
   C. It is not good for your health.
   D. They are mangoes.

27. What does 'À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink a juice.
   B. It is a cake.
   C. They are mangoes.
   D. At midday, I eat rice and beans.

28. Which little word goes with 'doigt' (the finger)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

29. What does 'J'ai deux pieds.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two feet.
   B. I have two ears.
   C. I have ten fingers.
   D. I have two eyes.

30. What does 'Où est la clé ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   B. Where is the key?
   C. The TV is on the table.
   D. The rug is under the table.

31. How do you say 'the baby' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. le père
   C. la grand-mère
   D. le bébé

32. How do you say 'the house' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la maison
   B. le canapé
   C. le livre
   D. la chaise

33. How do you say 'Friday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. vendredi
   B. lundi
   C. samedi
   D. mercredi

34. How do you say 'I sing' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je me repose
   B. je chante
   C. demain
   D. hier

35. How do you say 'Saturday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. samedi
   C. dimanche
   D. mercredi

36. How do you say 'the cake' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la mangue
   B. les fruits
   C. le pain
   D. le gâteau

37. How do you say 'the back' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le nez
   B. le dos
   C. la bouche
   D. les cheveux

38. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'shoulder'? (1 mark)
   A. èpaule
   B. épaule
   C. epaule
   D. épale

39. How do you say 'It is cloudy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du vent.
   B. Il y a des nuages.
   C. Il gèle.
   D. Il pleut.

40. How do you say 'the shop' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le jardin
   B. le magasin
   C. le tapis
   D. la clé

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'The bed is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Write the French words for: near, the rug, the key (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'I am well, thank you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Write the French words for: health, the cake, beans (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'La télé est sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'J'ai un nez.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Write the French words for: the hand, the back, the stomach (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'She is short.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'Excuse me, where is the school?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'Go straight ahead.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Explain how to search safely on the internet when you look for a text about the body. (4 marks) (4 marks)

52. Translate into English: 'C'est bon pour la santé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'How old are you?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Write the French words for: a flood, the wind, the storm (3 marks) (3 marks)

55. Write the French words for: the head, black, the foot (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'Turn right.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Translate into English: 'Il y a un canapé dans le salon.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

58. Write the French words for: in, the door, the chair (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Le vendredi, je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'Bonjour, Amina !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

SECTION A

1. A — Bonsoir, Madame !

3. B — Voici ma maison.

   The correct spelling is épaule, with its accents.

   It is cloudy. in French is Il y a des nuages..
